english:
Performing 3 Light Attacks within 1 second, then a Heavy Attack within 1.3 seconds of the last one while grounded, grants Sword Storm Combo for 5 seconds.

Sword Kills refresh the buff.

Sword Storm Combo automatically deals <pve 103 /> <pvp [?] /> Sword Kinetic damage and disorients enemies for 4 seconds every 0.53 seconds in a 6 meter radius around you, dealing up to 15% more damage within 4 meters.

source.text:
Upon performing 3 Light Attacks within 1s of each, followed by a Heavy Attack within 1.3s of the last attack, while grounded:
Grants Sword Storm Combo for 5 seconds.
Scoring additional Sword Kills refresh the buff.

Sword Storm Combo:
Automatically deals 103 [?] Sword Kinetic Damage and disorients on hit for 4 seconds every 0.53 seconds over 6 meters around the user.
Deals up to 15% more damage at <4 meters.
